requirements.text: \- Strong Python (asyncio, FastAPI) plus working knowledge of C\+\+, Rust, or Go
\- Solid CS foundations: graphs, relational theory, algorithmic complexity
\- Hands\-on experience shipping LLM features: RAG, tool use, agent frameworks (LangChain, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or custom)
\- Practical deep learning: transformers and PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow
\- Fine\-tuning / post\-training (SFT, LoRA/QLoRA, preference optimization), and the judgment to know when not to
\- Production infrastructure: containers, Kubernetes, cloud, CI/CD, observability
Full\-time · In person, SF Bay Area (Bay Area residence required) · $120K–$200K base \+ early equity
Nice to have: real\-time voice/speech, LLM serving (vLLM, TensorRT\-LLM, Triton), distributed training, open\-source work or shipped AI products.
We care about what you've actually built more than a list of tools. A CS/ML degree is useful but not required.
